cases.parseDetail: Model returned intent as a string and relation at top level; canonical schema requires intent:{text,relation}. No repair or independent retry was performed.

limitations: n=1 per condition; order fixed plain then tools; provider/network/cache and stochastic response differences are uncontrolled. The observed 1150ms difference is not evidence of a systematic speedup.
Case2 chose no tools, so this does not measure an executed read-tool round trip or multi-stream loop overhead.
Case1 completed the provider stream but failed the canonical parser; no valid packet exists for that run.
SDK usage is recorded exactly as reported, with cached input separate. No reasoning-token/text-token split was reported; outputTokens cannot be treated as visible JSON-only tokens.
canonicalWallMs spans interpretViaLlm plus canonical parse/render; fullHarnessAttemptWallMs also includes SDK/protocol setup and evidence persistence.

The measurements preceded the intent-string normalization fix; replayAfter is separate and did not repeat generation. Both requests used no conversation history or capability list, so these are isolated optimizer-model timings rather than a live chat end-to-end latency guarantee.
